units: Tosef. Neg. I, 5; Y. Succ. III, 53ᵈ איזהו י׳ שבירוקים which of the green colors is called y’rakrak? Answ … the color of wax &c.—Sifra Thazr. Par. 5, ch. XIV (ref. to Lev. XIII, 49; XIV, 37) י׳ ירוק שבירוקים y. means the palest of the pale (green) colors.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 11:4">ib.</cite> l. c. <he>י׳ שבירוקים</he> the palest of &c. Tosef. ib. V, 5; a. fr.—Fem. <cite ref="J00665"><he>יְרַקְרוֹקֶת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Megillah 13a:12">Meg. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>אסתר י׳ היתה</he> (Ms. O. <he>ירקרקות היתה כהדסה</he>) Esther was of a greenish complexion (like a myrtle).
